name: Treacherous Cases in Shendu
summary: Li Ya'er acts as his father's proxy to receive the bride who dies in a mysterious fire that very night. He is then attacked, loses his memory, and is enslaved. When a bloody conspiracy collides with the secrets of his identity, master and servant are forced into a tragic confrontation. Behind the masks lie true hearts, and beneath the strange case, deep feelings surge. Witness how a dual-faced princess and a cold-eyed killer join forces to unravel a conspiracy and protect the Tang Dynasty under the cover of darkness!

name: Lost in Moldova
summary: Diego joins the Peace Corps to win back his ex-girlfriend. He imagines exotic locales, instead he finds himself "Lost in Moldova." Follow his adventures as he navigates the cultural differences that divide us and the shared humor and humanity that unites us.

name: Black Death Patient Zero
summary: Black Death Patient Zero explores the origins of the 14th-century Black Death pandemic, using new DNA analysis to investigate its earliest victims. The show investigates the plague's spread from Central Asia, with filming locations in the UK, Italy, and Germany, and highlights scientific efforts to trace the pandemic's roots, such as the study of plague victims found in Kyrgyzstan in 1338 or 1339.

name: Most Wanted - A hajsza
summary: Most Wanted - A hajsza is RTL's new interactive escape reality show. 24 well-known Hungarian celebrities try to escape from Balázs Sebestyén and his team of professional pursuers - without a phone or money, dressed in orange prison uniforms. The goal: to evade the hunters. Viewers could also join the action - reporting if they spotted any of the fugitives, or even helping them escape through online platforms and social media. The format engaged the entire country, with thousands of reports submitted and hundreds of people offering assistance to the celebrities.

name: Exek csatája
summary: The past haunts, the grand prize tempts! Which couple will be able to move beyond past grievances and work together for victory and a prize of up to 40 million forints? In the special game Exek csatája, participants reunite solely for the sake of the reality show. Their goal is to complete challenging tasks while skillfully navigating the emotional tensions between them. The competition isn't just about the potential 40 million forint prize - it's also about proving that the past doesn't have to hold them back from overcoming the challenges of the present.

name: The Alibi
summary: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.

name: Dogfood Dan and the Carmarthen Cowboy
summary: Aubrey drives a load of 'Doggy Dins' dog food from Carmarthen to Hull, and Dan drives a load of 'Bona Fido' dog food from Hull to Carmarthen. They soon find - or rather don't find - that they have more in common than they think.

name: ПАПАШИ
summary: A show in which comedians don't discuss cars, politics or sports, but... fatherhood!

name: НОСТАЛЬЖИ
summary: This is a nostalgic show from Otar Kushanashvili and Roman Kositsyn. If you remember how you brought one roll to a tea party and ate two, then this show is just for you. Our guests are nostalgic for the nineties and two thousandths, answer questions and participate in activities related to that time.

name: ПОСЛУШАЙ, ЧТО СЛУЧИЛОСЬ
summary: "Listen to what Happened" is a new true edge show from the DELA community. This is a homely, cozy podcast in which guests come to the hosts Masha and Dasha to discuss stories about serial killers, cults, robberies, mysterious cases, unsolved stories. These are our interests. Make yourself comfortable, turn off the light and pour the tea. It's going to be creepy and interesting.

name: Son Kare
summary: After being suspended from duty and only able to work under the supervision of a psychotherapist, Homicide Squad Commissioner Sare Baykal faces the most complicated murder of her career, while her path crosses with fashion photographer Atlas Demiroğlu, who came to the police station because of a film full of mysterious images. The investigation, which begins with a woman's body found in an amusement park, soon opens the doors to a multi-layered puzzle that extends to both Sare and Atlas' pasts. As each new clue draws Sare and Atlas into a dark labyrinth, the boundaries between reality, fantasy, loyalty and betrayal become increasingly blurred.

name: Победители
summary:
Their breathing is ragged, their strength is at its limit, and each new stage is harder than the last. No staged scenes – only real emotions. Pushing a 150-kilogram log, then climbing without safety equipment, and after that, without a break, heading to the firing range. It's not just difficult – the obstacle course exhausts even seasoned athletes, and special forces veterans drop out of the race. Steep climbs, sharp descents, challenges at high altitudes. Participants need ingenuity and extreme focus. "Победители" is the first tactical extreme sports project on Russian television.

Teams led by Mikhail Koklyaev, Ed Khalilov, Marat Sutaev, and Svetlana Aplachkina will compete for the main prize, provided by REN TV in partnership with PSB Bank. Each of the mentors is a recognized master in their sport. And each of them has formed a team based on their own plan for victory.

In this honest and tough competition, the teams become stronger, their characters tougher. Drama in every episode, intrigue until the very end, and victory here will not come easily.

name: Surviving Mormonism with Heather Gay
summary: Heather Gay, star of "The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City" and New York Times bestselling author of "Bad Mormon," uncovers the dark history of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in "Surviving Mormonism with Heather Gay." The first episode premieres Tuesday, Nov. 11 at 9:15 p.m. ET/PT on Bravo, following a supersized episode of "The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City." All three parts will drop exclusively on Peacock on Nov. 12. The three-part limited series fractures the church's seemingly perfect veneer to expose the secrets that have been kept behind closed doors. In each hourlong episode, Heather has impactful conversations with abuse survivors, ex-Mormons and former LDS church leaders. As Heather reflects on her own departure from the church, "Surviving Mormonism" delves into outdated and controversial practices and empowers victims to share their experiences to bring awareness and enact change.

name: Där solen alltid skiner
summary: It follows Tom and Petra, a successful couple who built up a large Ica Maxi store in Linköping and sold it for a record sum to live a life of luxury in Mallorca with their sons. Ready to enjoy an eternal vacation, their lives suddenly take an unexpected turn during Tom's 50th birthday party, leading his brother Timmy and his wife Maja to move their family to the sunny Spanish island, where chaos ensues.

name: Гудовы
summary:
The Gudov family lives in a small village near Moscow. Sergei is the head of a close—knit family, he has everything in order: a faithful wife, a marriageable daughter, a farm, a house. He considers his brother Semyon to be a rotten branch on the family tree. After all, Semyon is a disgrace to the Goodovs' honest name, instead of a normal business, he commands a cemetery, sauna and microloans.

Sergei only lacks an heir, but suddenly Matvey appears in his house — a charming orphan boy who claims that he is his illegitimate son. From this moment on, the family idyll turns into a test for everyone, and the treacherous brother secretly seeks to take the family land for himself.

name: Knee High Spies
summary: A brave team of toy spies embarks on epic missions to save their beloved human family from the mischievous pet guinea pig Silver Paw.

name: No Strings Attached
summary: Real celebrities. Really saucy stories. Mel Giedroyc hosts the erotic showbiz book club where famous guests narrate racy fanfiction while naughty puppets bring their words vividly to life!

name: Belphégor
summary: Hafsa, a talented art restorer freshly hired at the Louvre, plunges into chaos when she comes face to face with a millennial mask of the storm god "Belphegor". Suddenly involved in a series of inexplicable disappearances, a race against time begins for her. To bring out the truth, Hafsa will have to fight against those who stake her... and against her ghosts.

name: Extra-Lucide
summary: Denise is an ordinary woman. Or almost. From a very young age, she has heard people's thoughts. No spirit resists him. How, under these conditions, to play the game of life in society? How to maintain a relationship of couple, friendship, family? How to love, how to be loved? Can we reasonably be lucid and happy at the same time?

name: Hype
summary: Milan, QT8 neighborhood. Anna, Luca, and Marco are three young people with a passion for rap music. When a prestigious record label takes notice of them, the three believe their breakthrough is near, but in the neighborhood nothing is ever guaranteed, and the group must contend with a drug dealer who doesn't want their success. With music by Ernia.

name: Les Mascots
summary: Dustin, a half-baked film major from LA, is sent to NYC to stay with- and make a documentary about- his uncle Henry, a supposedly ultra-successful Broadway actor. However, upon arrival, Dustin discovers a hidden truth: Henry shares a cramped apartment with an eccentric roommate Marlon. Worse, they scrape by performing as Elmo and Cookie Monster in Times Square. This is their story.

In this fantasy investigation series, investigators from two eras must hunt for the truth in old unsolved cases, communicating only through an old radio. The signal between the past and the present only opens at 23:23.

name: Аптекарь
summary: Five friends, acquaintances of the beer machine, from different professions, ages, and fate, threw off the bottle. And out of the bottle came a fairy named Bereginya, obliged to fulfill all the bottle owners' wishes.

name: Алые погоны
summary: A television series based on the novel of the same name by B. Izyumsky. It follows the fates of the students of the Suvorov Military School who honorably took up the baton from their commanders during the Great Patriotic War, and explores the present-day Soviet Army, shaping character, and cultivating courage in young soldiers.

name: Битва за небо. История военной авиации России
summary: "Battle for the Sky: The History of Russian Military Aviation" is a comprehensive 8-part documentary series produced by the Zvezda TV channel. The project covers more than a century of the evolution of the Russian air force—from the first wooden "shelves" of the early 20th century to today's fifth-generation supersonic fighters.

name: Без права на ошибку. История и вооружение инженерных войск
Желанная
summary: Our time. On her sixtieth birthday, Maria Grigorieva receives an envelope from a stranger. Inside, she finds a ring and an open letter signed with the pseudonym "Sweet Hedgehog." Maria recalls that this was what she used to call her numerous lovers. She mentally travels back in time to figure out who could have sent such a touching letter.

name: 13 знаков зодиака
summary: Each of us wants to know where happiness awaits. We'll look into the future and reveal all the secrets of the zodiac signs, including the power of the 13th sign.

name: Бешенл Джеографик
summary: The first humorous travel show. Comedians Max Perlov and Timur Rodriguez travel around the world, experiencing the most unusual experiences.

name: Ils vécurent heureux
summary: Emma and Leo get married, but will their love endure as they struggle against conformity?

previousepisode.name: La moins belle journée de leur vie

name: James May's Shed Load of Ideas
summary:
James May returns with a brand-new series, taking on the everyday frustrations that unite a nation in grumbles. From his Wiltshire home, his pub, and most importantly his shed, James sets out to dream up imaginative fixes for the problems blighting Britain and stirring up public annoyance.

Armed with his trademark wit and curiosity – and joined once again by his engineer sidekick Sim and series favourite Tony "The Tool" – James dives into a fresh set of challenges. Whether it's tackling practical irritations or exploring the country's bigger gripes, this inventive trio use humour, creativity, and a shed-load of tools to prove that no problem is too small (or too ridiculous) to try and solve.

name: Бес в ребро, или Великолепная четверка
summary: Four cheerful and close friends constantly get involved in different adventures. Each of them turned fifty, but they fill their lives with a bright, interesting meaning. Every day one of them gets into some kind of frivolous story. This is a series about love relationships, about the fate of four bosom friends and their true male friendship.

name: Невозможные зеленые глаза
summary: Alexander Litvinov belongs to the generation of Russian clerks. Glossy magazines impose on him a lifestyle he cannot afford; his environment demands success and professional ambition from him. Alexander's real estate career is not going particularly well; his last chance to turn things around is to get hold of a plot of land that once belonged to a pioneer camp. However, the land is occupied. Strange research is being conducted there. The aliens want to find out how humane humanity is and whether it's time to shut down the test site called Earth. To save civilization, Alexander must learn to live by different values.

name: Автономка
summary: About the lives of the crew members of the submarine "Varshavyanka". The crew members of B‑556 serve with dignity. The closed world of the submarine imposes its own conditions: there is no distinction between day and night here; you need to be on guard both day and night. But the sea prepares many unforeseen circumstances for the heroes. They will have to participate in rescuing a Russian tanker, help drowning fishermen, and assist oceanologists. Before that, the submariners will take on board the mysterious female pilot Galina, who was involved in a plane crash and ended up on the open sea. Her appearance on the submarine will stir up trouble in the hearts of some of the characters, and events will begin to unfold in an unexpected way.

name: Бальзаковский возраст, или Все мужики сво...
summary: Already from the title of the film it is obvious that we are talking about residents of a big city, charming young ladies of "Balzac age" - "a little over thirty". This age formula of "maturity and flowering" was brought out by the great French theorist (and, of course, practitioner) of love Honore de Balzac in his novel "The Thirty-Year-Old Woman". The second part of the name is a direct consequence of the first. What else to do for beautiful and unmarried girls, if not the search for love? Well, where is the search - there are mistakes, and disappointments, and those same "muzhiks" who sometimes behave like uniform "own ...". The combination of irony and sincerity, comedy and melodrama, recognizable situations of the difficult amorous life of a modern metropolis give this love-comedy cocktail an original, piquant taste. Vera, Alla, Sonya and Yulia are old friends.

name: The Haoge of Erlonghu: No Rogues Under Heaven
Hearts in Play
summary: Sunny and warm-hearted high schooler Xia Fanxing is known as the campus "hidden gem"—someone whose presence can soothe any wounded soul. Sheng Yang, a transfer student and former champion of the National Youth Table Tennis Championships, was forced to give up the sport for reasons he can't talk about. His world stays dim—until he meets her. Determined to help Sheng Yang step out of his shadows, Xia Fanxing tries every method imaginable, from gentle persuasion to hilarious tough love, leading to a series of funny and heartfelt mishaps. But as they grow closer, Sheng Yang gradually realizes that behind Xia Fanxing's bright smile and endless emotional support lies a pain she carefully hides from others. She wraps her wounds in sunshine, an introvert pretending to be an extrovert. After learning the truth, Sheng Yang makes a quiet promise: she can continue being the sun for everyone else—and he will be the sun for her. From that moment on, a tender, healing, and sweet love story unfolds.

name: Aerial Mexico
summary: Get a stunning view of the soul, strength and spirit of this historic land on Aerial Mexico

name: The One
summary: Adapted from a novel by Feng Huo Xi Zhu Hou, the story follows a small town that looks ordinary but is secretly on the verge of collapse. As powerful forces scheme using the town as their battleground, a humble young man, Chen Ping'an, dares to challenge fate with courage and determination. Armed with only a sword, he fights to survive and protect his path forward.

name: Feng He Jin Qi Zhang Ju Zheng
Алмазная тропа
summary: Repeated attempts to locate Siberian diamonds proved fruitless. The latest expedition began with a dramatic event: the sudden death of its leader. But the geologists decided to continue their journey. Thus began a difficult, perilous trek for a handful of people along the taiga's "diamond trail."

name: Блондинка и брюнетка
summary: Olga Zhuravleva is a successful dentist and the owner of her own small clinic located in a country hotel. But Olya is unlucky in love... She has been dating a married man for four years. One morning, she learns that he has finally divorced. However, her joy is short-lived, as he divorced not for her, a stern, serious brunette, but for a young and frivolous blonde.

name: Бобры
summary:
Vladimir Suvorov, a retired military man who spent 25 years in the Air Force, comes to visit Tamara, a saleswoman in the small village of Olkhovka. They met in the south, struck up a brief holiday romance, and Tamara couldn't imagine their story could continue. She invites Vladimir to live together for a while, get to know each other, and then decide what to do next.

Writer Kruglikov lives next door to Tamara. With his royalties, he could have lived in Europe, but he chose Olkhovka. According to him, this is the real Russia, which the city's intellectuals don't know and fear. At first glance, the village is a perfect idyll—everyone has a job, the best doctors in the region, and virtually no crime—live and be happy. But whether Suvorov will settle here is not up to him or Tamara to decide, but to the village's true master—Mayor Nikolai Bobr, who is accustomed to calling the shots and dictating the laws in his territory. Will Suvorov, who has spent his entire life following orders, be able to live by the rules by which all of Olkhovka lives?

name: Богини правосудия
summary: The plot centers on four wronged women and four vibrant and complex destinies. Valentina, a former police major unjustly dismissed from the force; Zoya, a self-defense instructor who was raped in her youth; Zhenya, cruelly abandoned by her husband; and Tatyana, who served several years in prison for slander… What connects these two so dissimilar women, and is their meeting a coincidence? Is revenge their sole motivation, and why are they called "goddesses of justice"?

name: История отечественного военного альпинизма
summary: Are you convinced that mountains are an impenetrable border? That ridges and sheer cliffs will stop any enemy? Such a belief can prove costly if relied upon in national defense. As past events have repeatedly proven, an experienced enemy can use the heights as a springboard for a surprise attack at any moment. This film explores the most heroic chapters in the history of Russian military mountaineering. It explores the complex art required to defeat the enemy even when the front recedes into the clouds. We'll explain when and why mountain rifle units were created, and why they are as indispensable today as they were centuries ago.

name: Анечка
summary: Alexey is madly in love with Anechka. She is the woman of his life. For her, he is willing to make any sacrifice, even take her blame and go to prison. Time passes, and Alexey discovers a talent for healing, learning from the herbalist Olga Afanasyevna. Believing himself to be responsible for the deaths of his loved ones, he readily gives up material possessions and embraces a reclusive lifestyle. Helping people becomes the meaning of his life.

name: Непокоренная красота
summary: The most amazing city on the planet! Emerging as if by magic, celebrated by poets, and surviving incredible trials. Petrograd. Leningrad. Petersburg. Its strength and magic remain in its beauty. The beauty that was sheltered, saved, and preserved during the war and the siege. Evacuating valuables, camouflaging domes and spires, preserving architectural monuments, hiding sculptures. What efforts did it take? And how was Leningrad reborn from the ashes of the siege?

name: Come Dine With Me: Teens
summary: Come Dine With Me: Teens will, for the first time in CDWM history, see five teenagers try their hand at cooking up a menu and hosting their own dinner parties over five nights. The 16–19-year-old competitors will score each of their competing hosts with a mark out of 10 and the overall winner will scoop a £1,000 prize.

name: V for Vendetta
summary:
Based on a comic serial written by Alan Moore and illustrated by David Lloyd. 

The story is set in Britain in a dystopian, not-too-distant future in which the country is controlled by the fascistic Norsefire party. An anarchist named V, known for his distinctive Guy Fawkes mask, seeks to topple the government with the help of Evey Hammond, a young woman V rescued from the country's secret police.

name: Money Honey Brainy
summary: The freelance queen Xin Tong, who never turns down a gig, takes on a task from her best friend: to sabotage a blind date. Unexpectedly, her target is Wen Pei'an, heir to the Sihai Group. Facing intense pressure from his parents to marry, Wen Pei'an seizes the opportunity and hires Xin Tong to be his contract girlfriend. Together, they must outsmart the relationship inspector sent by his father, launching them into a hilarious journey of cohabitation and pretend romance.

name: Surely Tomorrow
summary: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

name: Love is Always Online
summary: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan enters a virtual game in search of his first love, Yao Yuan, launching a heartfelt pursuit that eventually brings them back together in the real world. As they prepare for their wedding, an old family feud resurfaces, putting their relationship to the test. Through misunderstandings, heartbreak, and even illness, the couple endures every trial and finally reconciling and achieving their destined happy ending.

name: Petter og familien – dit ingen drar
summary: Petter Nyquist is taking his family out into the world! Now they will live with people who know war, poverty and climate change firsthand.

name: Shutline
summary: Moon Shingun, who makes a living by repairing cars on the street, is having a disappointing day until Jake Gillan appears with a broken car. Jake eyes Shingun up while asking irritating questions. However, Shingun can't afford to lose a customer offering a large wad of cash, so he gives Jake his contact information. Shingun's goal is to avoid danger and survive each day. Soon, he learns that Jake is a high-ranking gang member, and despite his efforts to stay away, Jake seems unwilling to let him go.

name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
summary: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. In a city that thrives in the spotlight of violence, one question remains: when the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

name: The Chase New Zealand
summary: The Chase is on Aotearoa! Four Kiwi contestants must pit their wits against the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius determined to stop them winning the cash prize. Hosted by Paul Henry,

name: Scout Elf Squad
summary:
The North Pole is always bursting with wonder, imagination, and play and now, Santa's newest team of heroes is ready to share that magic with the world's youngest dreamers.

Introducing Scout Elf Squad™, the brand-new animated preschool series from The Elf on the Shelf®!

name: Treasure War
summary: After the death of her husband, the leader of Loetwara business ring, Erin is being prevented by his cousin from inheriting his assets. At the same time, she needs to not only fight to survive but also preserve everything that rightfully belongs to her son. Everything she is confronted with, work, money and even love, comes seeking something from her. Erin calls all of this the war of money".

name: The Only Light
summary: Xu Xiao Yang grew up under the high pressure of her mother. She had to accept everything arranged by her mother. She always felt that she was ordinary. Even when she was in school, she had a crush on the school idol Fu Yan Li, but she didn't dare to approach him and could only escape. Ten years later, she was 29 years old and worked as a small employee in a bank. The long-term work pressure caused her ill health. She went to the hospital for treatment but unexpectedly met Fu Yan Li as the attending physician. She didn't expect that he was also her blind date. After her mother issued the final task of getting married, Xu Xiao Tang decided, after drinking, that since she was going to be with someone she didn't like, she would indulge herself with the person she had secretly loved for ten years.

name: Kampen om Pusher Street
summary: This docuseries details how one street became the epicenter of Danish drug crime -- as told by those living in and around the community.

name: My Nightmare Stalker: The Eva LaRue Story
summary: My Nightmare Stalker tells the harrowing true story of how Emmy® Award-winning actress Eva LaRue and her daughter Kaya endured 12 years of terror at the hands of a relentless stalker. Operating from the shadows, he taunted and terrorized their lives while his identity remained a mystery, even to the FBI. In this gripping account, Eva reveals the constant fear, emotional toll, and the resolve, courage and resilience it took to protect her family.

name: Younger Husband Is Deeply In Love With Me
summary: To take back her mother's company, Ye Qing Huan, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, planned to kill her father and keep her son. She chose Bo Yu Chuan in the club, but unexpectedly, Bo Yu Chuan was the richest man in Yancheng, with a net worth of hundreds of millions. He was in a car accident and lost his memory, and ended up getting together with Ye Qing Huan by accident. In fact, Bo Yu Chuan fell deeply in love with Ye Qing Huan many years ago. After regaining his memory, he hid his identity and helped Ye Qing Huan recover his mother's company.

name: Haunted Desires
summary: The story of a man trapped in an emotional and physical tug-of-war. Though he's been with his loyal and loving partner for years, the memories of his ex - who ignited a passion like no other - continue to haunt him. As her struggles with lingering desires and the comfort of his current relationship, he must decide whether to embrace the love he has or chase the fire he lost. Will he learn to let go, or will temptation pull him back into the arms of his past?

name: Sicilia Express
summary: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

name: Stygt?
summary: Are we building disturbingly ugly buildings in the world's most beautiful country? Hans Olav Brenner travels around to find out what the state of Norwegian architecture is like.

name: Nomad
summary: In the violent underworld of New Zealand's outlaw bikers, a warrior torn between two lives, two callings and two families must decide which path defines his true destiny.

name: The Cult of the Real Housewife
summary: The Cult of the Real Housewife traces the dramatic rise of Faith Temple from its founding by the beloved Rosemary ‘Mama' Cosby, grandmother of Mary Crosby, to her passing, the controversial transfer of leadership, and her husband's marriage to Mary. This hotly contested bequeathment pushed Faith Temple into a controversial, new era. In addition to exploring the church and the allegations against it, the docuseries will elevate the voices of ex-congregants speaking out for the first time, including long-standing pillars of Faith Temple, the Enoch family, and provide deeply personal and disturbing accounts from family members such as Mary's sister, Denise Jefferson Odinaka, and Mary's cousin, Dan Cosby, along with his wife, Kim. The docuseries also features investigative journalists and bloggers who have been tracking this story from the beginning, as well as a leading cult expert who can offer insight around a playbook designed to enforce loyalty in mind-control cults.

name: НА КУХНЕ
summary: "In the Kitchen" is a film project by Maxim Lagashkin and Maxim Peshkov, in which invited actors and hosts discuss the film industry on equal terms.

previousepisode.name: #3 | Денис Власенко, Максим Лагашкин и Максим Пешков

name: The Judge Returns
summary: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

name: Dérive
summary: Daniel Major, a prodigious pianist, finds himself unable to play. To heal, he must uncover the latent trauma causing his blockage. His quest for the truth, fraught with danger and pitfalls, leads him to a most disturbing revelation, leaving Daniel to face an agonizing moral dilemma.

name: 50 segundos: El caso de Fernando Báez Sosa
summary: This documentary series explores the case of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.

name: Portraits of Delusion
summary: Set in Gyeongseong in 1935, the series follows painter Yun Il Ho, who is tasked with creating a portrait of Song Jeong Hwa—a mysterious woman who has remained out of public view for more than half a century and is the subject of countless rumors. As he steps into her world, a web of secrets begins to unravel, pulling him deeper into a suspense-laced narrative.

name: Второй шанс
summary: Ksenia Borodina presents the show "Second Chance"—a show where those who have already experienced a breakup but are ready to take another risk for the sake of love meet.

previousepisode.name: #2. Пройдя газлайтинг и абьюз, она решила попробовать еще раз

name: Vengeful Wife
summary: Posing as the ideal husband, Ye Dong weaves a web of deceit to usurp the Lin fortune. He orchestrates a scheme that leaves his wife, Lin Xia, blind and coldly disposes of her father. Emboldened by her blindness, he brazenly betrays her with his secretary right before her. However, when extreme abuse from Ye Dong's mother triggers a miraculous recovery of Lin Xia's sight, her world shatters and reforms. A phoenix rising from the ashes, she sets out on a path of vengeance to make her tormentor pay and cleanse her world of his corruption.

name: Two Much with Kajol and Twinkle
summary: Two of India's sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that's fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone's invited.

name: The Human Bait
summary: In the chaos of the Republican era, two souls, once torn apart by a childhood kidnapping and misunderstanding, are reunited at an auction. Li Huang, now a powerful figure, purchases Lu Niansheng as her "gilded canary," only to find herself ensnared in his meticulously laid trap. A dangerous game of cat and mouse unfolds between captor and captive. From a crucible of torment and buried truths, they must unite to confront a greater enemy lurking in the shadows, forging their legend from a complex web of love and vengeance.

name: Yong Zhe Da Maoxian
summary: Scattered throughout the world is proof of an advanced prehistoric civilization. There exist those who desperately want to learn more about these ancient people. The series follows people who set out on an adventure to uncover the truth.

name: Glina. Nowy rozdział
summary: Officers from the Homicide Department of the Warsaw Metropolitan Police confront violence, death, and the dark aspects of human nature every single day. Joining the seasoned detectives Banaś and Jóźwiak is a young, ambitious police officer - Tamara Rudnik. Right from the start, she is thrown into the heart of the brutal Warsaw underworld, where the lines between good and evil often blur dangerously. As each investigation raises more questions than answers, the officers must face not only ruthless criminals, but also their own inner demons.

name: Impacts: Climates Change the World
summary: The entire Earth is affected by climate change, occurring with a greater speed and scale than ever before. This program uses scientific data and the latest findings to raise awareness on its impact.

previousepisode.name: World Heritage Under Threat: Episode 5 Protection through Education

name: Instant Décisif
summary: In each episode of Instant Décisif, we welcome a photographer whom we have asked to select three photos that have marked their life and their career.

name: Good Sports with Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson
summary:
The series celebrates a reunion of sports superfans and comedy superstars Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson for an all-new sports comedy talk show that will give fans a front-row seat to the ultimate crossover and transform the traditional world of sports commentary into must-watch TV. Powered by their signature unfiltered opinions and electrifying energy, Kevin and Kenan will offer hilarious takes on everything from the NFL and NBA to neighborhood pickup games and little league drama... because whether it's played in stadiums or backyards, all sports are Good Sports.  

Each episode will deliver a highlight reel of laughs, featuring exclusive interviews with the biggest stars in sports and entertainment, wickedly funny commentary on the week's top stories and highlights, and boldly original field pieces that will have viewers cheering from their couches. This is sports talk reimagined: louder, funnier and as unpredictable as overtime in Game 7.

name: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
summary: For the first time ever, experts identify Hitler's DNA. What do his genes reveal about Hitler's heritage and origins, his neurology and drives?

name: Europe's Wild Marvels
summary: From the icy desert of Svalbard to the sun-kissed Mediterranean, this six-part wildlife series explores Europe's most important and fascinating habitats and meets their most remarkable wild inhabitants. Blue whales, polar bears, and soaring golden eagles star alongside rarely seen marvels such as the rare Persian leopards. Packed with spectacular imagery and new-to-science behaviour, Europe is one of the most ambitious wildlife series ever made.

name: Me late que sí
summary: There's always a story behind the winning numbers. This work of fiction based on true events follows five normal people who tried to cheat the lottery.

name: Hustle Show
summary: Meetings with people who have achieved success through persistence and courage. The participants share stories from their lives, discuss their paths toward their goals, and reflect on what "hustle" really means – that inner drive that won't let you give up.

name: Kodenavn: Storfyrstinden
summary: The true story of the young bank clerk Jutta Graae, who is swept into the resistance movement when Germany occupies Denmark.

name: HELLO! NHK WORLD-JAPAN
summary: What's on NHK WORLD-JAPAN. Showcasing various programs and activities of NHK WORLD-JAPAN which provides the latest information on Japan and Asia to the global audience.

name: Antiques Roadshow Recut
summary: Antiques Roadshow Recut features thirty-minute episodes, packed full of favorite finds and paced for maximum entertainment.

name: Lego Marvel Avengers: Strange Tails
summary: Hawkeye and The Avengers have made saving the world look easy. But now they face their wildest threat yet: SOCIAL MEDIA. To save the world, a new team must be recruited to help our heroes contend with an influencer bent on cataclysmic destruction.

name: Reborn as a Cat
summary: Ji Miaomiao, a young woman just starting her career, is betrayed by a friend and left with a mountain of debt. While fleeing from ruthless debt collectors, she accidentally falls from a building. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure transforms her into a cat. By a twist of fate, she ends up being adopted—by none other than her own boss, Lu Chengze. Thus begins her strange and magical 100-day life... as a cat.

name: Bill Bailey's Vietnam
summary: Join comedian, raconteur, and musician Bill Bailey as he travels the length of modern Vietnam on the 50th anniversary of the dramatic withdrawal of the US forces from Saigon. Immersing himself in its rich culture, stunning landscapes, and complex history he uncovers what makes this fascinating country tick. From the centuries old hill tribes of the north, to the bustling markets of Ho Chi Minh City and the breathtaking hidden beaches of Ha Long Bay, Bill will show that there is so much more to this country than a legacy of war and conflict. Vietnam is a country that is always looking forward despite its past. Vietnam is unpredictable, chaotic and – at times – infuriatingly bureaucratic… but these are things Bill embraces on a journey no ordinary traveller would dare undertake beyond the tourist trails.

previousepisode.name: Группа "Аквариум" во главе с Борисом Гребенщиковым

name: Gruvan
summary: We go deep underground and get to follow the people, technology and some of the world's largest machines that keep Sweden's industrial heart pulsating - around the clock, all year round.

name: Cancer Detectives: Finding the Cures
summary: Cancer Detectives: Finding the Cures explores the pioneering research that could transform the future of cancer detection, treatment and prevention.

name: Tide of Love
summary: Han Jae-hoon is a wealthy heir who hides his pain behind cold indifference while Kim Hae-jun, a bright art student is burdened by life's weight. What begins as a transactional relationship gradually transforms into a tender bond. In their shared solitude and unspoken care, they slowly draw closer, yet the thing that binds them keeps them from confronting their true feelings. As the tide rises and secrets surface, they must decide: will they remain confined by the rules, or will they dare to love?

name: To my shore
summary: You Shu Lang, a director at a pharmaceutical company, lives an ordinary, stable life. But that all comes crashing down after he gets into a car accident with Fan Xiao, the heir to a Thai conglomerate who's returned to China for business. Unlike Shu Lang, Fan Xiao's life has been marred by instability, leading to a twisted, manipulative worldview. When Fan Xiao finds out that Shu Lang is interested in men, he devises plans to entice Shu Lang into a relationship, but ends up falling for Shu Lang for real. Shu Lang, on the other hand, is blindsided when he learns about Fan Xiao's true colors. Will Fan Xiao destroy the only genuine love he's ever had, or can he find a way to truly win Shu Lang's heart?

name: Running Hunters
summary: Set in 1920s Yongxin City, the mysterious death of an antique shop owner and the theft of priceless relics ignite a tense battle. Singer Du Qing, Detective Hanzhou, and Luo Ting must overcome mistrust and work together to protect the artifacts and outwit powerful enemies.

name: Truth & Treason
summary: When loyalty to country becomes loyalty to a lie, one teen risks everything to expose the truth. With the Gestapo closing in, he must decide what it really means to be a good German. This four-part series expands on the film.

name: Entre Irmãs
summary: In the 1930s, two sisters separated by destiny face prejudice and sexism: one from the big city's high society, the other from a group of renegades in the back country. Emilia is romantic and marries a rich young man who is full of secrets. Luiza, of a wilder nature, falls in love with an outlaw who provokes mixed feelings in her. In this feminine and intimate epic, the sisters know they only have each other and both will surprisingly leave their marks in the world.

name: Shodha
summary: After his wife vanishes following a deadly accident, Rohith reports her missing. When police find her, he insists the woman isn't really his wife.

name: Sekizinci Aile
summary: From a modest beginning to becoming the most powerful family in the world, the Basmacigiller struggles to protect their top place.

name: So You're Raising a Warrior
summary: Ell, the strongest dragon in the Demon Realm, wants one thing: to die, so he can relax in the afterlife. Unfortunately, that's easier said than done. After accidentally offing yet another hero, Ell has an idea. If no warrior can slay him, he'll just raise one who can! After meeting the magician Lafi, Ell begins raising her son, Dino, for this purpose. So begins his hardest quest yet, parenthood.

name: Rise of the 49ers
summary: San Francisco 49ers dynasty, during the 1980s and early 1990s, a struggling football team transforms into the sport's most dazzling and successful franchise, becoming the talk of the league.

name: Я готова отдать за сына ВСЁ!
Sex, Money, Murder
summary: Sex, Money, Murder is an eight-part true crime docuseries exploring a string of murders that shook communities across the U.S. from the late '90s to the mid-2000s. Each episode investigates a different case, but every trail leads back to one common thread: the strip club. Packed with secrets, shocking twists, and betrayals you'll never see coming, this is where lust, cash, and blood collide.

name: Basic Bitch Bærum
summary: Four friends in their early twenties fumble their way through minor and major disasters on their journey into adulthood. They want to be "strong, independent women" — it's just a bit exhausting to be that all the time.

name: Frier und Fünfzig – Am Ende meiner Tage
Yeliz & Jimi – We Are Family?!
summary: Reality documentary with Yeliz Koc and Jimi Blue Ochsenknecht: Will the former lovers find their way back to each other as parents to their daughter Snow?

name: Parterapi i Gagnef
summary: One chaotic day, psychologist Nisse forgets confidential medical records on the bus. A total disaster. He loses his job and is relegated to a job in Dalarna and a position at the health center in Gagnef. Not much to live for, Nisse thinks. But the charming Rebecka at the hardware store still brightens up Nisse's everyday life, until he suddenly meets her in her role as a couples therapist.

name: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
summary: They may live in the smallest state in the country, but their drama? Extra large. Bravo is expanding the distinguished franchise with The Real Housewives of Rhode Island, spotlighting a fresh, charismatic group of women whose lives intertwine across the storied coastline of New England luxury.

name: The Valley: Persian Style
summary: This series follows a tight-knit group of Persian friends who have traded Beverly Hills for suburban life in the Valley. Rooted in their culture that values family, friendships and loyalty above everything else, emotions often take over as these fiery personalities navigate their highs, lows and everything in between.

name: Bai Fen Bai Xin Dong Ni
Onvergetelijke Liedjes
summary: What happens to songs once written by an artist but never finished or released? Simon Keizer gives these songs a second chance by commissioning another artist to create a new, unforgettable version.

name: 7de Laan
summary: 7de Laan is an extraordinary microcosm where good and bad, evil and wholesome characters find themselves forming part of a wholesome community where no matter what, everyone counts and everyone cares.

name: To the Beat!
summary: A series of youth dance competitions ignite friendships and dreams.

name: Лепила
summary: In the past, Sergey Rashidov was a successful surgeon who, by coincidence, had to radically change his profession and even his name. Now he is Djura's janitor, forced to live on forged documents. During the morning cleaning, he finds a wounded bandit named Conrad. Filled with medical duty, Rashidov provides him with first aid, and then secretly treats him in his janitor's room. Major Alyoshin, an employee of the homicide department, becomes aware of the circumstances of the shooting, and Konrad's rival, the leader of a criminal group, the owner of a nightclub nicknamed Lucky, finds out where Konrad himself is. Fearing revenge, Lucky decides to blow up a competitor's car and find and punish the doctor who helped Conrad.

name: Lucky Swan
summary: Sompho has lived with her single mother Nongnuch since birth. They have to contend with a sharp-tongued landlord, Paula. Working at a resort, Sompho meets Kumpha who was sent to look after two VIP guests. There's a misunderstanding and, thinking her a thief, Kumpha nearly turns Sompho in to the police.

name: Steal
summary: Steal is a contemporary, high-octane thriller about the heist of the century and the ordinary office worker, Zara, who finds herself at the heart of it. A typical work day at a pension fund investment company, Lochmill Capital, is upended when a gang of violent thieves burst in and force Zara and her best mate Luke to execute their demands. But who would steal billions of pounds of ordinary people's pensions and why? DCI Rhys is determined to find out, but as a recently relapsed gambling addict, Rhys must keep his own money problems at bay while dealing with the secret agendas and competing interests at the center of this far-reaching crime.

name: The 1% Club Rollover
summary: The 1% Club Rollover works the same way as the original show, but if the prize pot is not won on one show, it will rollover to the next day's show. If all the pots rollover, there could be up to £500,000 being up for grabs!

name: Iyanla: The Inside Fix
summary: Iyanla: The Inside Fix will bring Iyanla's fresh perspective to twelve of the most impactful episodes, exploring how the challenges we face and the ways we heal have evolved in today's fast-changing world. This new series invites viewers to reflect, reframe and reconnect with the lessons that still matter most.

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: Merit Wins the Soul
summary:
This is the story of a web novelist who's found great success in her career, yet failed miserably in love. One day, she meets a beautiful model—a woman who makes her fall in love at first sight and sparks her desire to open her heart again.

Even though her best friend warns her this woman is dangerous, known for her scandolous affairs and casual relationships, she refuses to believe it. She's convinced that if she shows enough kindness and love, she can change her. As their relationship develops and she does her best to love sincerely and give selflessly, she often forgets to be kind to herself.

As her partner continues in her ways, she chooses forgiveness rather than to walk away. One day, however, a shocking truth forces her accept the truth of her situation.

name: Hija del fuego: la venganza de la bastarda
summary: A Patagonian town is shaken by the arrival of Letizia, a foreign woman preparing to marry a powerful local businessman. Her presence arouses suspicion, but no one suspects the truth: she is the key to a bloody revenge plot. With everyone's trust, she sets her plan in motion and commits the most brutal crimes in a town that hides more secrets than it seems.

name: Thundercloud Rainstorm
summary: At his uncle's funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn't seen in years. It turns out Iljo's struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn't keen on dating him, but somehow, he's a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen?

name: Hiru no Yume another side
summary:
"Hirunoyume Another Side" (昼のゆめ another side) is a spin-off drama within a fictional drama that aired on TV Tokyo. It's a key part of the narrative of the series "25:00, Akasaka de Season 2" (25時、赤坂で Season2).

The spin-off, "another side", focuses specifically on the plot and characters of this fictional show "Hirunoyume" itself. While only fragments of "Hirunoyume" are shown in the main series, "another side" reveals the entire story of the show-within-a-show.

name: Sevdiğim Sensin
summary: Sevdiğim Sensin tells the story of Dicle, a village girl whom Istanbul native Erkan saves from his cruel brothers by marrying her during his military service, and their journey that extends to Istanbul. Believing in this marriage with her pure heart, Dicle steps into Istanbul's glittering yet harsh world, unaware of the planned marriage Erkan's family wants for him.

name: Las hijas de la criada
summary:
Galicia, 1900. Two girls, Clara and Catalina, are born at the Pazo de Espíritu Santo. Clara belongs to the maid, Renata, while Catalina is the daughter of the Valdés family, Don Gustavo and Doña Inés.

An unexpected act of revenge will shake the lives of these girls and all those around them, forcing Doña Inés to survive heartbreak and the pain of abandonment. She will also have to navigate the power struggles to make her true daughter the heir to an empire, in an era when women were not allowed to be masters of their own destinies.

name: Gu Jinnan Prisoner
summary: 17-year-old Wen Hai lost his parents in an accident. Since he was underage, the court appointed his wealthy half-brother, Gu Huaizhou—whom he had never met—as his guardian. Gu Huaizhou despised Wen Hai's arrival and treated him with cold cruelty. Though Wen Hai appeared obedient, he secretly resented the abuse. Gu Leng manipulated Wen Hai's emotions to take revenge on Gu Huaizhou, but his schemes backfired. During this time, Gu Leng also became entangled with debtor Jiang Nan, whose resistance turned into love and ultimately ended in tragedy. Meanwhile, Wen Hai and Gu Huaizhou's relationship shifted from hostility to reluctant reconciliation and forbidden attraction. Yet their bond was shadowed by blood ties and moral boundaries they could not escape. Eventually, after Gu Leng drugged Gu Huaizhou, everything between them shattered.

previousepisode.name: Miles Davis, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Hank Crawford, Abbey Lincoln and Phil Woods, Kronos Quartet

name: Yakarta
summary: José Ramón Garrido is a former Olympic badminton player who now works as a physical education teacher at a public school in Vallecas. Divorced and disillusioned, he discovers in a school tournament a teenage player, Mar, who could be his ticket to fulfill his dream of competing in Yakarta, the city where former players like him are respected as stars.

name: Sparks of Tomorrow
summary: This was a little while ago. Kyoto in the early 20th century, having evolved differently from the history we know today. In a world where only steam engines had advanced, the city was shrouded in smoke. A boy who lost his brother, with whom he had dreamed of the "Age of Electricity," and now lives with deep suspicion. A girl who keeps her dreams for the future and her regrets for her deceased mother hidden in her heart, now living a devout life. The boy and girl meet while seeking the secret of the "20th Century Electrical Catalog," which depicted their dreams. Surpass who you are now and break through the dreams you once had! This is the story of regeneration.

name: Gorgeous Dream
summary: Shen Wanqing, condemned as "impure" after spending four years in prison, was ruthlessly hunted down by the Liu family for the sake of their reputation. After being reborn with a new face as the merchant's daughter Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to exact her revenge, using herself as bait to capture the hearts of both father and son. To make the Lius pay, Lan Mengyan deliberately walks into danger, until Qin Moxiu, who has been secretly watching over her, can no longer sit idly by...

name: Play It Forward
summary: Join Renee Montgomery along with Kel Mitchell and Jesser as they come in and work behind the scenes to surprise local youth and sports teams.

name: Top Scholar, Your Wife's at It Again!
summary: Qin Yu, the newly appointed top scholar, marries Zhang Qiong, the notorious 'shrew' known for miles around, to repay a meal she treated him to three years ago. Unexpectedly, this sets off a life-and-death situation entangling both domestic strife and court politics. Qin Yu, who appears gentle and frail on the surface, is actually a covert royal agent entrusted with the crucial task of investigating corruption in disaster relief efforts. The bold and fearless Zhang Qiong fights with wit and courage against her ruthless uncle to protect her younger sister. The couple work hand in hand with one heart to benefit the people.

name: ¿Apostarías por mí?
summary: "¿Apostarías por mí?," a new multiplatform reality show, broadcast live 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The show will challenge 12 celebrity couples who will give up their privacy to live completely exposed as they face tests, bets, and temptations on their journey toward one goal: proving how far they're willing to go for each other. The couple that earns the audience's votes and proves they can overcome it all will take home up to $300,000.

name: K-Everything
summary: Across four immersive episodes, K-Everything follows Daniel Dae Kim on a quest to discover how South Korea has sparked a global pop culture movement, driving trends in music, food, TV and film, and more. From Busan to Seoul, Kim will trace the roots of Korean culture featuring cameos from some of the biggest names driving South Korea's creative renaissance.

name: A (Very) Musical Christmas
summary: Some of Australia's finest musical talent grace the stage with the sounds of the festive season for an enchanting Christmas. Featuring Eddie Perfect, Cody Simpson, Casey Donovan, Justine Clark, Tim Draxl, Jason Arrow and more.

name: Zerhun
summary: The Şerzanoğulları are one of Mardin's oldest and most powerful tribes. The wealth and influence they have amassed over the years have made them a prominent family not only in the region but throughout Türkiye. However, at the core of this empire lies dark secrets, deep wounds, and broken lives. A story with deep roots and a burning heart. On one side, secrets linger in the shadow of the past. On the other side is the burning price of love. But, the silent walls of stone mansions will no longer hide secrets. With scenes shot in the captivating atmosphere and on the enchanting cobblestone streets of Mardin, the series isn't just a story. It's the rebirth of a legacy, a betrayal, and a passion. In this world where love, legacy, and revenge intertwine, nothing will be as it seems. The years-old feud between two long-established families is now reignited in a completely different form. Amidst that reckoning, a forbidden love blossoms. In each episode, viewers will step into the world of characters who battle both the past and the voice of their hearts. Zerhun isn't just a love story...It's a profound journey that will make you question the heavy price of reputation, prestige, and legacy. Every scene features heart-wrenching moments that will leave you glued to the screen. Because Zerhun isn't just a series... It's a story of destiny.

name: Dustfall
summary:
Dustfall is a propulsive, atmospheric Tropic Noir that follows a detective whose deep sense of justice is challenged by a world where victims are doubted, predators hide in plain sight, and the legal system too often falls short.

When seasoned detective Tig, returning to her hometown of North Gap after years in the city, uncovers a string of drink spiking assaults, the case is turned on its head when one of the main suspects is murdered.

name: The Blueprint with Jen Psaki
summary: Democrats are looking to regain power, and whether it is the urgency for generational change, the right approach to fighting back or the issues that should be front and center, there is a whole lot of warranted debate about what a winning formula looks like. "The Blueprint" is a forum where those discussions take place. MS NOW's Jen Psaki sits down with some of the biggest names on the left side of the political spectrum to talk about confronting Trump 2.0 and how the Democratic party can succeed at shaping the future they'd like to see. This is a space for thought-provoking, honest discourse where Jen goes beyond political talking points to determine "the Blueprint" for what lies ahead.

name: Treasure & Dirt
summary: In a dying opal town in the middle of the desert, law and order are little more than myths. Thieves raid the mines, zealots preach salvation to the lost, and billionaire magnates play god. When a miner is found beheaded and left to decompose in the depths of his own small claim, big-city homicide detective Ivan Lucic is sent to investigate. Assigned to him is former local constable Nell Buchanan, who knows how this place really works — and how it warps people. Together, they're drawn into a labyrinth of secrets, greed, and old sins that won't stay buried. As the case twists into something darker and more surreal, Ivan and Nell can't tell whether it's the town  that's unravelling or themselves

name: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
summary: From street eats to elegant restaurants, Justine Schofield explores the dynamic flavours of Hong Kong. Join her as she samples iconic dishes, meets local culinary masters, and brings the taste of Hong Kong into her own kitchen.

name: Jasmine Harman's Renovation in the Sun
summary: Jasmine Harman's no stranger to helping others find their perfect place in the sun. Now she and her family take the plunge and transform a run-down villa into their new home on the Costa del Sol.

name: Farm 999
summary:
Farm 999 features dramatic farmyard accidents, rural crime investigations, heroic rescues and raging fires from some of the UK's most beautiful but isolated communities.

The series gets access to previously unseen CCTV, body cam and mobile phone footage from the incidents alongside the personal accounts of those involved.

Each episode brings viewers into the heart of these dramatic events following the challenges faced by emergency services in the air and on land who tend to life and death situations in often remote and inaccessible locations. It also follows police operations and investigations in these areas cracking criminal gangs and clamping down on the perpetrators.

previousepisode.name: Neglected Birds Found and Highland Blaze Seen from Space

name: Lost Treasures of Ancient Civilizations
summary: Join host Dan Snow as he travels around the world to bring us the stories behind some of the world's most famous treasures of ancient civilizations.

name: Civilisations: Rise and Fall
summary: Four mighty civilisations - Rome, Egypt, Japan's Samurai and the Aztecs. Their legends remain - now priceless artefacts reveal what led them to fall into the echoes of history.

name: The Great B&B Challenge
summary: Six couples compete to win the prize of a lifetime – a five-bedroom B&B in the heart of rural France. Four expert judges decide who gets sent home and who gets to keep the keys.

name: The Unlikely Cook with Awkwafina
summary:
The Unlikely Cook with Awkwafina Nora embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy.

Nora's family ran Lum's, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York, and the very first in a now thriving Chinatown. But despite growing up in the family business, she can't cook. At all. She could ruin an instant ramen.

name: Angus Ashworth: Yorkshire Heritage Hero
summary: Auctioneer Angus Ashworth is heading to some of Yorkshire's big country houses in a bid to help save and protect some of the country's most incredible houses.

name: 5-Star
summary: The most elite freshmen in college football navigate the pressure of fame, expectation, and glory.

name: Wo De Zu Mu Shi Chuan Yue Nu
The Best Sweet Love of Youth
Gua Fei Ta Yao Ni Tian Gai Ming
На ногтях
summary: Nail technicians from all over Russia will compete for the title of best in their field. Contestants will have to demonstrate their skills and expertise to impress clients and the celebrity judges with their unique designs and meticulous work.

name: Команды
summary: A humorous show for those who appreciate smart humor and want to have a great evening in the company of old friends. On the same stage are legendary bands from the world of KVN, for the first time without judges, scores and competitive tension. There will be no winners or losers, just laughter and the brightest performances from the teams that have already become part of the Club's history.

name: San Xing Dui Li You Ge Cun
Karaoké Club
summary: Six celebrities will take part in the longest karaoke night! They'll face off in a friendly – yet ruthless – competition, as at the end of each episode, they'll have to eliminate one another. They know they're coming to sing, but they have no idea about the surprises and twists the host has in store for them! At the end, only one will win the prestigious trophy. Are you ready to party with them?

previousepisode.name: Min dröm är att bli bäst i Sverige
10 likes så känner algoritmen dig bättre än dina vänner
